shots.visual: A sweaty thumb presses a red button on a black remote control with trembling force.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 跟我一起下地獄吧！

shots.visual: Total silence in the room. The luxury furniture remains intact. No explosion occurs.
Maniacal expression turns into confusion, eyes widening as he looks at the remote.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 怎麼可能？這不可能！

shots.visual: Standing calmly with hands behind back, looking down at the antagonist with pure disdain.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你在等煙火秀嗎？

shots.visual: A cold, razor-sharp smile appears on his face. Cinematic lighting highlights his eyes.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這遙控器，五分鐘前就被替換了。

shots.visual: She walks into the hall wearing a sharp suit, holding a tablet and a real remote control.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 趙總，您手裡那台只是個兒童玩具。

shots.visual: He frantically presses the button multiple times, his face turning pale and desperate.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 賤人！妳敢背叛我？

shots.visual: She stops in front of him, looking at him like he is a piece of trash.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 我從未效忠過你，何來背叛？

shots.visual: Walking slowly toward the desk, picking up a glass of wine and swirling it.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 離間計用得不錯，但我弟弟死的時候，我親手葬的他。

shots.visual: Eyes turning icy cold, staring straight into the camera lens.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你想讓他背鍋？他也配？

shots.visual: Stepping back, tripping over a rug and falling onto the leather sofa.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 就算炸彈是假的，當年的證據也是真的！

shots.visual: She taps the tablet screen. A hologram or screen glow reflects on her face.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 你是說那些偽造的銀行流水嗎？

shots.visual: A video starts playing on the wall-mounted TV showing the antagonist signing documents.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 這才是五年前，你一手遮天的原始錄音。

shots.visual: The video plays a grainy CCTV of the antagonist laughing while framing the protagonist's family.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 我要陳家所有人都跪在我腳下求死。

shots.visual: His face turns from pale to gray, jaw twitching in shock.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你……你怎麼拿到的？

shots.visual: He walks up and grabs the antagonist by the collar, lifting him partially up.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 在獄中五年，我每天都在想這一天。

shots.visual: He whispers into the antagonist's ear, voice low and dangerous.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，你最後的底牌爛透了。

shots.visual: She hides behind a pillar, trembling, her face full of terror and regret.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 哥……我們完了，全完了。

shots.visual: He pushes the protagonist away weakly and tries to run toward the door.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 滾開！我還有龍騰集團！

shots.visual: She shows a digital stock market graph on her phone; the line is crashing vertically.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 剛接到消息，龍騰集團已經破產清算了。

shots.visual: He stops dead in his tracks, looking around the hall as if seeing it for the last time.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 破產？這是我一輩子的心血！

shots.visual: He throws a file onto the coffee table with a loud bang.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你的心血，是用我全家的血換來的。

shots.visual: He collapses to his knees, staring at the documents on the floor.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 求你……留一條活路給趙家。

shots.visual: Looking down with an expression of pure, cold justice.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 當初我求你的時候，你有給我活路嗎？

shots.visual: He starts laughing hysterically, a sound of total mental collapse.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 哈哈哈哈！大家都別想好過！

shots.visual: He lunges toward a hidden panel behind a painting on the wall.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 我還有最後一招！

shots.visual: She raises an eyebrow, completely unfazed by his erratic behavior.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 想啟動地下室的毒氣裝置？

shots.visual: He checks his luxury watch with a calm, methodical gesture.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你已經沒有時間了。

shots.visual: Suddenly, faint siren sounds start growing louder from outside the mansion.
He freezes, his hand touching the hidden panel, face filled with pure panic.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 警察？你竟然報警了？

shots.visual: He adjusts his cuffs, looking ready to leave the scene.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 我說過，要讓你合法地在地獄待一輩子。

shots.visual: She runs out and tries to grab the protagonist's leg, crying hysterically.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 陳峰！放過我，我都是被逼的！

shots.visual: He kicks her hand away without even looking down.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 妳的髒手，別碰我的衣服。

shots.visual: The room is flooded with red and blue emergency lights reflecting through the windows.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 我不服！我絕不認輸！

shots.visual: He suddenly pulls a hidden lever. A loud mechanical sound vibrates through the mansion floor.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 那就全城陪葬吧！
